# REQ: LANG-1461 LANG-1462 LANG-1463
use v6;

class Greeter {
    has $.name = 'world';
    has @.history;

    method greet(Int $times = 1 --> Str) {
        my $text = "Hello, $!name!\n";
        @!history.push($text);
        return $text x $times;
    }
}

my %ages = ann => 30, bob => 25;
my $g = Greeter.new(name => 'Raku');
say $g.greet(2) if %ages<ann> > 0 and True;
for 1..3 -> $i { put $i * 0x1F }
